_comment: The other half of the Wirewood Lodge viewer rule (2026-08-23): when its {G} is NOT payable the option must NOT be offered to a human -- 'a plan menu must never contain a silent no-op option'. Board: untapped Lodge (which makes {C}, not {G}), a TAPPED Elvish Archdruid (so the tapped-Elf gate passes) and a TAPPED Forest with no Arbor Elf to untap it, so nothing can produce {G}. Without the human-play trial-pay gate the action is enumerated here and the click does nothing: everything upstream reasons about the over-approximate AvailableManaPool while the trailing apply pays through the exact TapForCostDirect. Autonomous enumeration deliberately keeps the looser gate (its trailing apply runs after the plan's casts, which enumeration cannot see) -- see stompy_lodge_burst.json for the burst it needs that looseness to find.
